result.topic_en: Brief notes on the period matrix of a genus-2 theta function (periods πi and a_{i,j}), the effect of shifting the arguments by periods, and a product of theta functions with shifted arguments, with a small sketch.

methods.what: Period scheme of a genus-2 theta function: periods πi in the diagonal and the symmetric matrix a_{i,j} as second set of periods
General translation of the arguments by an integer combination of periods
Transformation of a variable by a multiplier factor under period shifts
Product of λ² theta functions with arguments shifted by points a^{(ν)} (e.g. division of periods by λ)
